class.name: GameplayServerPrediction
class.brief_description: Server-authoritative validation and consumption of numbered inputs.
class.description: GameplayServerPrediction owns authoritative movement states. It accepts intent only from the server-recorded owner and rejects duplicate, older, excessive-gap, invalid-step, invalid-vector, and rate-limited commands. Clients cannot provide position or velocity through this API.

method.name: consume_input
method.description: Validates the real sender and command, advances authority, and returns an accepted snapshot or deterministic reason.

method.name: get_last_rejection_reason
method.description: Returns the latest rejected input reason.

method.name: get_rejected_input_count
method.description: Returns the number of rejected commands.

method.name: set_object_owner_peer_id
method.description: Rebinds authority to a new transport peer after a verified session reconnect.

members.member: Per-object accepted input limit in a one-second window.
